description: ShellMenuView - list the static context menu items of Windows Explorer and disable the unwanted ones
notes: The app auto-elevates: every launch raises a UAC prompt, because disabling a menu item writes to HKLM.
Settings go to shmnview.cfg next to the exe - pre-created as an empty file so scoop persists it as a file, not a directory junction.
A translation file (shmnview.exe /savelangfile writes shmnview_lng.ini) is deliberately not persisted: an empty placeholder would be loaded as an empty translation and blank out the UI.
The download URLs carry no version, so checkver watches the PAD manifest and every version bump re-hashes the same two zips.
